name: Silixiz's Tower Key
summary: Foreman Silixiz carries the key to the Venture Company tower near the Sludge Fen. Shattered Hand operatives must take it from his pocket as part of an undercover sabotage assignment.

sections.title: A Test of Subtlety
sections.body: North of the Sludge Fen, the Venture Company keeps its tower under tight security. Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix oversees the isolated lookout, while goblin mercenaries patrol the compound. Outside, Foreman Silixiz carries the tower key. A Shattered Hand operative from Orgrimmar must steal it and keep it. Force will not do: the operative must enter unseen and pick Silixiz's pocket, proving their stealth before climbing into the tower's toxic upper levels.

faq.q: Where do I find Foreman Silixiz?
faq.answer: Foreman Silixiz is outside the Venture Company tower, directly north of the Sludge Fen in the northeastern Barrens.

faq.q: Can I obtain the key by killing Foreman Silixiz?
faq.answer: No. The key cannot be taken from Silixiz's corpse. An operative must pick his pocket while he is alive.
Shattered Hand contacts assign the key to be delivered to Shenthul, the rogue trainer in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: What is the key used for?
faq.answer: The key proves an operative infiltrated the Venture Company's tower near the Sludge Fen. It is delivered to the Shattered Hand with Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix's head and the cache of Zanzil's altered mixture.

angles.text: As a Horde rogue, taking Silixiz's Tower Key is a trial for entering the ranks of the Shattered Hand. It demands skill in sneaking and pickpocketing.
As a member of the Horde, you carry a trophy tied to efforts against Venture Company exploitation and chemical experiments in the northern Barrens.
